description: Confirmation of existing use of first and loft floors as a House in Multiple Occupation (Use Class C4) prior to the borough wide Article 4 Direction coming into force on the 11 December 2025 (Application for a Certificate of Lawful Development for an Existing Use)
decision_conditions: The alleged existing development does not constitute Lawful Development under Section 191 of Town and Country Planning Act 1990, Section 191 as amended by Section 10 of the Planning and Compensation Act 1991, as it involves the subdivision of the existing property into two separate planning units, given that the alleged HMO use is asserted within the application to relate to the first and loft floors only.

Under Section 55(1) and (3)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, the creation of two separate dwellings/planning units from a single dwelling, as in this case, constitutes development, requiring planning permission. In this instance, no such permission has been granted, and given the date of the alleged subdivision, such development would not be immune from enforcement action.
